hold_text: Prop order path (src/prop/phone_cancel.py, phone_executor.claim_next, the phone claim route) plus phone-app Kotlin and exec.js: Tier 2 per the lane dispatch (PHONE-ENTRY-CANCEL). why: breakout_2 has no cancel path (exec.js DENY_WORDS/NOT_EDIT forbid it, the VM cancel path serves VM accounts only), so an expired resting limit (prop-manual-c1391d5720b1) stays at the venue.
